_note: Hex values are eyedropper-approximated from brand-assets/ptc-color-palette.jpeg (the color reference image) and the logo files. Verify against the source design / Adobe / Figma file before launch — these are starting points, not authoritative.

typography._status: Working defaults, approximated from ptc-font-example.JPG. Free Google Fonts equivalents — swap to commercial originals (Trajan / Avenir / etc.) later if licensing allows.

display.rationale: Trajan-style Roman capitals matching the logo wordmark. Use for the logo lockup and page H1s only — too formal for body.

body.rationale: Warm humanist sans used on the business card body copy. Default for all UI text, headings (H2+), and forms.

scriptAccent.rationale: Connected formal script seen on 'Sara Primrose' on the business card. RESTRICTED USE — personal-name treatments, signatures, decorative pull-quotes. Never body copy, buttons, navigation, or anything that needs to be readable at <24px.

primary.description: PtC monogram with cross-shaped 't'. Use as primary header logo, favicon source, and anywhere a refined/professional mark is appropriate.

secondary.description: Illustrated mark (baby with pacifier). Use for softer/family-facing contexts: social, hero illustrations, marketing collateral, child-care service pages.
